items.title: Claude Code has a hardcoded instruction telling Opus 5 not to use subagents
items.why_it_matters: It's been discovered that Claude Code has a hardcoded instruction preventing Opus 5 from using subagents. This means Claude Code might not break down complex tasks into smaller, autonomous sub-tasks as expected. You can adjust your prompting strategy this week by explicitly breaking down large tasks into smaller, sequential steps yourself when using Claude Code, rather than relying on it to do so autonomously.

items.title: Claude Code Deletes Your Context History from Your Device After 30 Days
items.why_it_matters: Claude Code now deletes your context history from your device after 30 days. This is an important detail about data retention and privacy for a tool you use daily. You should be aware of this policy this week and, for any long-term projects or crucial code snippets, make sure to save important context or generated code externally if you need access to it beyond 30 days.

items.title: You can view a lot of Claude shared conversations via Google
items.why_it_matters: It's been reported that many Claude shared conversations are viewable via Google search. You could review your own Claude shared conversations this week and adjust your sharing habits, ensuring no private project details are inadvertently exposed.
